list.title: Workouts
list.subtitle: Pick a workout and go. The app handles rounds, rests and the timer.

ready.resumeHint: This workout is already running. Picking up at set {n}.

summary.title: Workout done
summary.subtitle: Write down how it went — this is what shows up in your progress later.

quit.title: Quit the workout?
quit.body: Completed sets stay saved. The workout stays open, so you can pick it up later.

access.title: Subscription required
access.body: Workouts are part of the subscription. Activate it to start training.

notFound.title: Workout not found
notFound.body: It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.
